name: create-taproot
//name: Unscoped on purpose. `npm create taproot` resolves to the package `create-<name>`, so the documented command only works from an unscoped `create-taproot`. Under the @taprootcms scope the command would be `npm create @taprootcms`, which is what everybody would then have to remember.
//js: Plain .mjs rather than TypeScript, and no dependencies. This runs through `npx` on a machine that has installed nothing, so it cannot have a build step and cannot afford an install before it starts. The prompts are node:readline/promises.
